examples.arabic: هي كانت عايزه فساتين واسعه وأنا كنت بدور على بنطلونات جينز
examples.english: She wanted wide dresses, and I was looking for jeans.
examples.transliteration: Heya kanet ayza fasateen was3a w ana kont badawwar 3ala bantalonat jeans

examples.arabic: هي بتشوف فساتين كتير ومبسوطة اوي
examples.english: She sees many dresses and is very happy.
examples.transliteration: Heya betshoof fasateen keteer we mabsoota awi.

examples.english: Do you have nice dresses, Sara?
